mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of instances over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic recovery begins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to predict positive SPX returns in more than 55% of periods over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1400 thousand units signal a housing sector contraction, reducing consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% immediately compresses short-term discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as portfolio rebalancing occurs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth below 1.0% signals economic deceleration, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% over a 5-year rolling window.
